title: Independence Day USA
creator_credit: United States Information Agency and John G. Fuller
brief_description: Describes the various ways in which individual Americans celebrate their Independence Day, July 4th. They honour the heroes responsible for the Declaration of Independence and the national ideals of human rights embodied in it.
